memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: Make tassels on the four corners of the cloak you wear. - Deut 22:12 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
God instructs His people to make tassels on the corners of their garments. This might seem like a small, curious detail, but there was real purpose behind it. Elsewhere Scripture explains that these tassels were meant to remind the people of God's commands, so that when they looked at them, they would remember to obey the Lord and stay faithful to Him. The tassels were woven reminders, stitched into everyday clothing.

What a kind provision from God. He knows how forgetful we are. In the rush of daily life, it is easy to lose sight of Him and drift from His ways. So God gave His people simple, visible reminders woven right into the clothes they wore each day. Everywhere they went, a glance at their garment could turn their hearts back to the Lord.

We may not wear such tassels, but we still need reminders to remember God. Our hearts are just as prone to wander and forget. This is why God gives us His Word to read daily, gatherings with His people, the Lord's Supper, and countless everyday moments that can turn our thoughts back to Him. We can build helpful reminders into our own lives, a verse on the wall, a habit of prayer, a moment of thanks before meals. The goal is a heart that keeps remembering God through the ordinary day. What reminders help you keep God near in your daily life?

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. What helps you remember God during your busy day?
2. Where do you most easily forget the Lord?
3. What simple reminder could you build into your routine?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, You know how easily I forget You. Help me build reminders into my life that keep turning my heart back to You each day. Amen.
